name: Anima modulation guidance (pooled-text adapter steering)
plain: Uses a small trained adapter (a 2-layer MLP, optionally with a sigma-dependent FiLM) that turns a pooled text embedding into a vector added to the model's normalised time embedding. The positive and negative prompts each get their own base vector on their own CFG row, and on top of that a steering vector, adapter(quality tags) minus adapter(quality negative), is added with weight w to the time embedding entering a chosen range of transformer blocks (optionally tapered, optionally at the final layer). It needs no extra model passes, but it is tied to Anima's module names (t_embedding_norm, t_embedder, blocks) and the default adapter is downloaded from the pack's GitHub release if missing.
math:
Symbols: A(·) adapter MLP: A(p) = W2·SiLU(W1 p + b1 [⊙(1+γ(t)) + β(t) with FiLM]) + b2; p_pos, p_neg, p_tag, p_qneg pooled text vectors; e_t normalised time embedding; ℓ block index.
Base: e_t ← e_t + A(p_pos) on cond rows, e_t + A(p_neg) on uncond rows.
Steering: δ = A(p_tag) − A(p_qneg); before block ℓ: e_t ← e_t + w(ℓ) δ, w(ℓ) = w for start ≤ ℓ < end, w·taper_scale for the last `taper` blocks of that range, 0 elsewhere; final layer gets final_w·δ.
Profiles on the simple nodes: off, step_i8_skip27, step_i14, uniform_w3.

props.hook: APPLY_MODEL wrapper plus forward hook on t_embedding_norm and forward pre-hooks on blocks and final_layer
props.architectures: Anima (and the code paths name MOSS for Spectrum, not for this)
props.params: Advanced: quality_tags, quality_neg, mod_w=3.0, mod_start_layer=8, mod_end_layer=27, mod_taper=0, mod_taper_scale=0.25, mod_final_w=0.0, adapter; simple: mod_w_profile=step_i8_skip27
props.network: auto-downloads pooled_text_proj-0611.safetensors when the default adapter is chosen
